title: Special Tool For Disassembly Of Engine Pen-type Fire Coil Remover
body_html:
Product information :
Ignition Coil Puller Tool - VAG.
Designed for dismantling of ignition coils, which are mounted directly on the spark plug.
VW Golf from 2013, Audi A3 from 2013, SEAT Leon from 2013, Skoda Octavia from 2013 fitted with 1.2, 1.4 and 2.0L FSI chain engines.

Packing list:
Extractor*1
